def.flavor:
Riposte of the sworn Wardens.

The enemy commits; the Bastion answers, and its answer is always the greater. So the Wardens taught the drill, and so they told of the Spring Wars, in which they claimed never to have struck first.

The Northern Holds remember it otherwise.

def.flavor:
Parry upon the guard of a rondel dagger.

Favoured by the Bastion's older sellswords, who kept the short blade long after the Wardens ceased to issue it. The rondels came from the Northern Holds as tribute, and were worth more than a season's wage.

They bear a crest no herald of the ring recorded.
def.name: Rondel Parry
def.textTemplate: Gain {block} Block Prepare Melee Counter: return {poiseDamage} Poise when the full incoming action is absorbed. Return +2 Poise against Smash.

def.flavor:
Ward of shadow, after the eclipse.

During the eclipse the Observatory cast no shadow, which the Starwatch recorded as a curiosity of the light. The apprentices upon the terrace cast shadows as ever.

Theirs fell toward the Observatory, not away.
def.name: Umbral Ward
def.textTemplate: Prepare Spell Counter. Gain {gainBarrier} Barrier. Starstone: {gainBarrier.2} instead.

def.flavor:
Guarding light, after the Fixed Lamp.

A star above the coast that did not move with the others. The Starwatch took it for a flaw of the lens and reground the lens twice. The star remained.

After the Spire was finished, the log names it only "the error".
def.name: Warding Star
def.textTemplate: Prepare Spell Counter. Gain {gainBarrier} Barrier. Starstone: draw {draw} card.

def.flavor:
The string drawn, the breath held.

A dock archer waits for the tide bell, when every head on the quay turns at once. The bell has rung at the wrong hours since the Burning.

The archers have learned to wait for the heads instead.
def.name: Nock and Wait
def.textTemplate: Draw {draw} cards. Become Prepared. Prepare Ranged Counter: return {poiseDamage} Poise when the full incoming action is absorbed.

def.flavor:
The blade caught, turned, and held aside.

A duelling master of the Court taught it for coin to anyone who asked, dock thieves among them. When the Court learned whom he had taught, it stitched his hands.

He teaches it still, by describing it.
def.name: Binding Parry
def.textTemplate: Gain {block} Block. Become Prepared. Draw {draw} card. Prepare Melee Counter: return {poiseDamage} Poise when the full incoming action is absorbed. Return +2 Poise against Smash.

def.flavor:
Shield with nails driven through the boss.

The nails are from the Bastion's own gates. It is said a sellsword made it on the night of the Burning, from the gate he was hired to hold. His name is not known.

No bearer since has drawn the nails.
def.name: Spiked Reprisal
def.textTemplate: Gain {block} Block. Apply {bleed} Bleed. Prepare Melee Counter: return {poiseDamage} Poise when the full incoming action is absorbed. Return +2 Poise against Smash.

def.flavor:
Winter keeps the answering touch.

The Starwatch kept bowls of water beside the lenses through winter. Apprentices learned to read the skin of ice before it cracked. Their notes survived the Burning, folded inside cloth that still stiffens when a stranger touches it.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.
def.name: Frost Counter
def.textTemplate: Gain {gainBarrier} Barrier. Prepare a frost Counter: 2 Ward and 1 Poise return.

def.flavor:
The hearth sends another flame home.

The Bastion's night watch carried coals between the outer posts. A dying ember could reveal a footprint beneath fresh snow, or warn a sleeping guard before the gate gave way. Every watchman learned to keep the smallest flame alive.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.
def.name: Fire Counter
def.textTemplate: Gain {gainBarrier} Barrier. Prepare a fire Counter: 2 Ward return.

def.flavor:
The returning current remembers every rail.

Storms found the Observatory's iron stairs long before any scholar could name their path. Apprentices marked the scorched rails, then wrapped their hands in dry cloth. The surviving diagrams begin with a warning to watch where the current returns.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.
def.name: Lightning Counter
def.textTemplate: Gain {gainBarrier} Barrier. Prepare a lightning Counter: 2 Ward return.

def.flavor:
A held weight waits for its answer.

At the Basalt Stair, porters steadied heavy crates without touching their broken handles. The Astronomer recorded the trick as a measured displacement. Those who carried the crates remembered only the sudden weight in their wrists when their concentration failed.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.
def.name: Force Counter
def.textTemplate: Gain {gainBarrier} Barrier. Prepare a force Counter: 0 Ward and 3 Poise return.

def.flavor:
An old seam closes against the blow.

The Chapel's masons sealed cracks with dust gathered from the same stone. Their wards borrowed the patience of the wall rather than the strength of its builders. When the doors fell, several harmless seams remained closed against the rain.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.
def.name: Alteration Counter
def.textTemplate: Gain {gainBarrier} Barrier. Prepare a alteration Counter: 1 Ward and 1 Poise return.

def.flavor:
The second reflection keeps its distance.

The apprentices worked beside darkened lenses until they could distinguish a reflection from its source. One kept a second chair for a companion nobody else remembered. The chair was found warm after the Observatory had stood empty for years.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.
def.name: Illusion Counter
def.textTemplate: Gain {gainBarrier} Barrier. Prepare a illusion Counter: 1 Ward and 1 Poise return.

def.flavor:
A patient lamp answers the darkness.

Pilgrims carried little lamps through the Chapel's long passages, tending each flame before their own food. The rite outlived the voices that taught it. An empty hand held over a stranger's wound still remembers the warmth of that watch.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.
def.name: Divine Counter
def.textTemplate: Gain {gainBarrier} Barrier. Prepare a divine Counter: 2 Ward return.

def.flavor:
The bitter garden receives another seed.

Gardeners beneath the Chapel sifted bitter ash through exhausted soil. A root could be fed or strangled by the same handful, depending on the season. Their last ledger names each bed twice, once for its bloom and once for its silence.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.
def.name: Decay Counter
def.textTemplate: Gain {gainBarrier} Barrier. Prepare a decay Counter: 2 Ward return.

def.flavor:
The last arrow finds a sheltered hand.

The Chapel's masons sealed cracks with dust gathered from the same stone. Their wards borrowed the patience of the wall rather than the strength of its builders. When the doors fell, several harmless seams remained closed against the rain.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.
def.name: Barrage Interception
def.textTemplate: Gain {gainBarrier} Barrier. Prepare a alteration Counter: 1 Ward and 1 Poise return.

def.flavor:
The worn stones teach the lower answer.

Recruits practiced on the Bastion's worn courtyard until their boots found the same stones without looking. Veterans watched the shoulders rather than the weapon. After the Burning, the surviving lessons were passed from one tired pair of hands to another.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.
def.name: Low Guard Riposte
def.textTemplate: Gain {block} Block. Counter Melee attacks for 3 Poise; +2 Poise while Prone.

def.flavor:
Pain remembers the direction home.

A wounded veteran taught recruits to count their breaths instead of their cuts. The first breath kept the hand steady. The second found the opponent again. The third belonged to the return stroke, if there was enough life left to spend it.

Make the next breath your own.
